featured_reviews.name: Sameer Ghadi
featured_reviews.review_text:
5/5 Stars – Perfect Maharashtrian Catering for Ganesh Jayanti Feast!
We ordered from Santosh Catering for Ganesh Jayanti on 22-01-2026, and it was flawless! Parcel service for lunch (30 people) and dinner (50 people) – both deliveries were super smooth and right on time.
Lunch Menu (30 pax): Paneer Lazeez, Sukha Batata Bhaji, Chapati (3 per person), Jeera Rice, Dal Fry, Koshimbir, Papad, Achar. Every item was delicious, fresh, and packed with authentic Maharashtrian flavors – the Paneer Lazeez was a highlight! Best part: completely soda-free (no baking soda powder), so all tastes were pure and natural.
Dinner Menu (50 pax): Veg Kolhapuri, Bhendi Masala, Chapati (3 per person), Jeera Rice, Dal Fry, Koshimbir, Papad, Achar. The Veg Kolhapuri had the perfect spicy kick, and portions were generous for our big group – again, soda-free for genuine flavors.
Prices are very reasonable for the quality and variety, making it ideal for celebrations. Highly recommend – Santosh Catering nailed it!

featured_reviews.name: Raviraj Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Positives:
1. The food taste was good.
2. The decoration was nice.

Negatives:
1. The manager literally coerced me to give a 5 star review. Well! You better give me a good service for that but HELL NO! THEY DIDN'T!
2. The servers with starters just did NOT come to the row where we were seated, which was RIGHT NEXT to where they were entering from.
3. I told the manager herself, and the other boy who was sub-manager, not once or twice but multiple times, and even then they didn't give us starters even 1 damn time!
4. I agree, we were here for the function and not just for the food. But if you are behind my back for a review, might as well provide a good service.

So overall, I really would not recommend their services. I'm sorry, if you check my other reviews I am mostly very considerate.

But these guys just didn't listen to my request at all. They just kept on bringing water and juice. What do you want me to do? Overdose on liquids and keep peeing?

Also there were barely any chairs for us to have lunch. And I had to keep my plate next to the person who was collecting used plates. Nice!

So my sincere request to them is that please instruct your robotic like serving staff to apply some brains as to where to serve next instead of going to the same place like ants. While I agree that every profession should be respected but then do it properly and not for the sake of it or atleast your manager should observe it.

1 star is for their taste of food and the other is for the decoration. That's it. You asked me how were the starters without even serving me and gave me 1 paneer tikka to review and never to come back again. 😂 Hilarious!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hey Daley,

Thank you from the depths of our hearts for the love, passion, and effort you poured into the catering for our wedding. From the very beginning, you treated the food as if it were for your own family; giving careful thought to every single dish, from its conceptualisation to truly understanding the tastes and preferences of both mine and Veron’s. That level of care is rare, and it meant more to us than words can express.

Having experienced your exceptional work at my brother’s wedding three years ago, there was never a doubt in our minds that you had to be the one to cater our wedding as well. Once again, you went above and beyond, exceeding every expectation we had.

Our wedding was a beautiful amalgamation of Goan and Mangalorean traditions, and you handled it with such sensitivity and perfection. You ensured that every guest’s taste palette was thoughtfully considered, and it brought us so much joy to see every single person enjoy each and every bite. The love for your food was felt in every compliment, every smile, and every empty plate.

Your commitment, warmth, and genuine care did far more than just feed our guests. You brought people together, created moments of happiness, and became a meaningful part of our story. We will always cherish the memories you helped create on our special day.

Thank you for standing by us, for understanding our vision so beautifully, and for giving so much of yourself to our wedding. We are truly grateful and will always hold this close to our hearts.

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Dhamapurkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have ordered from Shri Ekvira Caterers on multiple occasions, and each time they have delivered an exceptional experience. They catered for my wedding festivities including Mehendi and Haldi, as well as my mother-in-law’s retirement party at her office and party hall and every event was handled with absolute perfection.

The food quality is outstanding — hygienic, fresh, flavourful and consistently delicious. Every dish reflects their commitment to taste and quality. Their kothimbir vadi deserves a special mention — it was included in all our events and became an absolute favorite among our guests. It was always perfectly crisp, flavourful and irresistible. The chicken prepared for the Haldi function was another highlight — incredibly tasty, well-cooked and loved by everyone.

What truly sets Ekvira Caterers apart is their professionalism and clear communication. From planning to execution, everything is smooth and stress-free. They always suggest excellent menus based on the occasion, guest profile and preferences, which makes decision-making easy and ensures a perfect dining experience.

Their service, presentation, punctuality and attention to detail make them a reliable and trusted choice for any celebration. I highly recommend Shri Ekvira Caterers to anyone looking for amazing food, hygiene, quality and seamless service. They truly make every event memorable! 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Dipesh Gad
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the pleasure of engaging Ekvira Caterers for our wedding functions for four days, and the experience was truly outstanding. Their team demonstrated exceptional attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to quality service.

The food quality was the highlight of the entire event. Every meal was fresh, authentic, and rich in taste which was truly comparable to home cooked food. The flavors were perfectly balanced, and the same was appreciated by all our guests. It is rare to find wedding catering that delivers both large scale service and such homely taste, but Ekvira Caterers managed it

The staff was courteous, well organized, and ensured smooth operations throughout all four days without any delays or issues. Their dedication made our wedding functions stress-free and enjoyable for us and for guests as well.

After experiencing such excellent service and food quality, I confidently referred Ekvira Caterers to one of my close friends, who also took their service and was delighted with their quality of food and service.

I would highly recommend Ekvira Caterers to anyone looking for reliable catering with authentic taste and superior service quality. They truly made our wedding celebrations memorable with their exceptional culinary experience and flawless execution

Highly recommended if you’re looking for reliable catering with amazing taste we’ll definitely be ordering again!

featured_reviews.name: Dipankur Bhogte
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the absolute pleasure of engaging Chef Neha Pradhan for our daughter’s 10th birthday celebration, and we couldn’t be more thrilled with the experience! Every dish she prepared was a masterpiece and added immense joy to our special day.

The **birthday cake** was nothing short of magical – beautifully crafted, moist, and delicious, it stole the show and brought a huge smile to our daughter's face. The **chicken biryani** was aromatic and perfectly spiced, leaving our guests raving about it long after the party ended. Her **chicken chilli** struck the perfect balance of flavor and heat, making it an instant hit with both kids and adults. And to end on a sweet note, the **mango mousse** was light, refreshing, and heavenly – a delightful summer treat that truly impressed everyone.

Chef Neha's attention to detail, professionalism, and passion for food clearly shone through in every bite. We are incredibly grateful for her exceptional service and culinary artistry. Thank you, Chef Neha, for making our celebration truly memorable!
